source_evidence: Non-traded REITs typically do not provide an estimate of their value per share until 18 months after their offering closes.
answer: A non-traded REIT’s share value may be hard to assess because it does not trade on a stock exchange, where a market price is readily accessible. The REIT typically may not provide an estimate of its value per share until 18 months after its offering closes—potentially years after you invest. During that time, you may be unable to assess the investment’s value or how much its value fluctuates. This is a transparency risk distinct from the difficulty of selling the shares.
